description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorDao data access object within the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup and test methods to verify retrieval of display field groups, display fields, and filter fields from the DAO.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorDao data access object.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, loads test data, and creates an instance of ReportGeneratorDao.

methods.name: testGetDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all display field groups, asserting there are exactly 16 groups.

methods.name: testGetAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all display fields, asserting there are exactly 105 fields.

methods.name: testGetAllFilterFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all filter fields, asserting there are exactly 13 fields.
